description: This file defines a React component and related functions for rendering and managing console log entries within a trace viewer UI, including parsing and formatting console messages, errors, and warnings.

methods.name: useConsoleTabModel
methods.description: Custom React hook that processes trace model events to produce a filtered list of console entries for display.

methods.name: ConsoleTab
methods.description: React functional component that renders the console entries list with formatting, icons, and error/warning indicators.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats console message arguments into React elements, supporting printf-style formatting and ANSI to HTML conversion.

methods.name: formatAnsi
methods.description: Converts ANSI text to React elements with HTML content.

methods.name: parseCSSStyle
methods.description: Parses CSS style string into a style object for inline styling.

methods.name: supportProperty
methods.description: Checks if a CSS property is supported based on prefixes.
